integrity: All numerically stated counts derive from an exhaustive finite search over 16384 admissible wirings with an independent rooted-Euler-tour enumeration and literal-factor comparison; the universal law has a direct proof.
scientific_limitations: Universal mod-four and four-factor floor applies to binary cyclic de Bruijn words for k>=2; sharpness at all k is not claimed.
Exhaustive pair-count spectrum and unique best-partner frequency are established only for k=5.
Independent audit and external validation were not performed.
A related 2025 generalization was inspected through accessible indexed sections rather than complete article; unexamined literature may contain overlap classifications.
title: Mod-four overlap law and complete order-five spectrum of binary de Bruijn cycles
